payload.title: PHI Configuration Overview
payload.body: This report expands the same PHI Card and birth-coordinate baseline. It reads configuration, motion and structural position; it does not establish your present circumstances.

cards.title: INTEGRATION
cards.subtitle: Bringing separate parts into one workable whole
cards.oneLineInsight: The issue may lie less in any single part than in how the parts work together.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: Several structures, demands, or reality layers need to be understood within one coherent frame.
cards.flowingExpression: Different parts can remain distinct while forming a workable whole.
cards.strainedExpression: Forcing sameness can erase the relationships that actually need coordination.
cards.observationPrompt: Which two apparently separate parts need to be considered together?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: CALLING
cards.subtitle: A direction keeps drawing attention and investment
cards.oneLineInsight: Some directions keep returning not because they are fully understood, but because their attraction remains real.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card points to a persistent directional attraction. Even before the reason is fully understood, attention, curiosity, investment, or imagination keeps returning to the same direction. Calling does not prove that direction is correct; it means the theme is persistent enough to deserve observation and validation rather than dismissal.
cards.flowingExpression: When the calling increasingly aligns with real-world evidence, attraction can become clear direction and meaningful investment.
cards.strainedExpression: When calling is romanticized, persistent attraction can be mistaken for a guaranteed answer while practical conditions are ignored.
cards.observationPrompt: What direction keeps drawing your attention across different stages, and what real-world evidence supports continuing to explore it?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Compare the leading baseline driver with what actually receives attention and energy in the current situation.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Does the current Reality reinforce this driver, or has another driver become more important?

cards.title: DISCERN
cards.subtitle: Recognizing the distinctions that actually matter
cards.oneLineInsight: Understanding and discernment can turn mixed signals into clearer judgment.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: The capacity for recognition, interpretation, comparison, and workable understanding.
cards.flowingExpression: Understanding changes the frame, not just the amount of information.
cards.strainedExpression: Analysis without a stopping condition can deepen indefinitely without producing a usable judgment.
cards.observationPrompt: Which distinction, once clear, would change your understanding of the whole situation?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether this capability is actually available under pressure, not only when conditions are easy.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What real evidence shows that this capability is available right now?

cards.title: WITHDRAWAL
cards.subtitle: The system narrows new input and connection to protect stability
cards.oneLineInsight: Protection can preserve stability, but when it keeps expanding it can also close off new input and possibility.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card describes a system reducing input, connection, and openness to avoid further load, conflict, or uncertainty. Some contraction can be protective, but if it keeps expanding, boundaries that once preserved stability can become restrictions that block new resources, relationships, information, or change.
cards.flowingExpression: When contraction is intentional and bounded, the core can be protected while preserving the ability to reopen later.
cards.strainedExpression: When withdrawal keeps expanding, the system can become increasingly dependent on existing structures even when new support or opportunities appear.
cards.observationPrompt: Which protective moves are still necessary, and which have begun to restrict useful new input?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the stated question actually becomes important in the situations where this grammar pattern appears.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Where does this baseline question match lived reality, and where does another question become more important?

cards.title: SUPPORT
cards.subtitle: When conditions are present, the structure can operate with less friction
cards.oneLineInsight: Real support lowers operating cost rather than merely adding encouragement.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: Conditions that open an entry, provide resources, or make operation more available.
cards.flowingExpression: When support conditions are clear, the structure needs less force to stay active.
cards.strainedExpression: When support replaces responsibility, external conditions can become dependency.
cards.observationPrompt: Which condition, if present, would noticeably reduce how hard you need to push?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the surrounding field and your actual response are moving in the same way or in different ways.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: What changes when the environment supports a different motion than the embodied response?

cards.title: OPENING
cards.subtitle: An entry is becoming possible
cards.oneLineInsight: The structure is at a point where operation can begin, but this does not mean it already has.
cards.canonicalCustomerMeaning: This card represents the opening position of the ECR baseline activation window.
cards.flowingExpression: The entry and its conditions are recognized without treating possibility as fact.
cards.strainedExpression: Treating an opening as an outcome can let expectation outrun evidence.
cards.observationPrompt: Which conditions have only just become possible?

contextualEvidence.observableSignal: Observe whether the current situation shows the opening, strengthening, over-amplification, decay or closure implied by this stage.
contextualEvidence.realityComparisonQuestion: Which part of this activation stage is supported by current evidence, and which part remains open?
